title: Aromatic Crispy Indian Vegetable Vada
description: A sour, crispy, and energizing Indian dish featuring roasted vegetables and ferment-jang, this macrobiotic-friendly vada is a perfect snack. It combines the flavors of Gujarat with the benefits of fermented food.
instructions: Drain and rinse the soaked chickpeas, then grind them into a coarse paste using a food processor.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the chickpea paste, chopped onion, grated carrot, chopped green chili, and grated ginger.
Add the ferment-jang paste, lemon juice, and salt to the bowl and mix well.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small patties, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter and 1/2 inch thick.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat until it reaches 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
When the oil is hot, add a few of the patties to the pan, being careful not to overcrowd it.
Fry the patties until they are golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes on each side.
Remove the fried vadas from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the vadas hot with your favorite chutney or raita.
